claim: Q80 mixed-1p5-v1 complete token after recon-fuse is a closed 14-component ledger. Median-wall decode token 250,732,125 ns. sum(components)=250,732,125 ns (0 ns rounding). GPU matvec is 36.533 ms (14.6% of wall), not 74%. The token is now dominated by 337-CB wait tax (83.375 ms), host catalog reparse of already-uploaded weights (68.416 ms), and host DeltaNet recurrence (43.518 ms). gk_*_simd is unused and SLOWER than the shipped tg256/simd3 kernels.
confidence: HIGH on closure, GPU timestamps, greedy identity, and the three named mechanisms. MEDIUM on occupancy (launch-geometry derived, not a hardware counter) and on exact ns recoverable from CB fusion (not measured as a fused production token).

measurement.label: DIRTY_ENGINEERING
measurement.regime: warm after 4 discarded tokens; 3 production 12-token generates; isolated/probe/simd suite after production rep 1; sealed from the median-wall decode token (n=33 decode steps). Waited on gpu lock held by g002-per-facet-ab-warm at start.
measurement.gpu_authority: completed MTLCommandBuffer GPUStartTime/GPUEndTime after wait; never a CPU-wait proxy
measurement.kernel_runtime_genome: Qwen80MixedHybridDecodeSession recon_fuse=true facet1=true facet2=true; q80_binary_group_matvec_tg256 + q80_binary_group_csr_matvec_tg256 + q80_uniform8_matvec_tg256/simd_bytes + q80_hgravs01_factor_matvec_simd3; host DeltaNet/GQA/RMS/topk; 337 CBs / 2413 dispatches

instrumentation_overhead: Production dispatch_threads always takes Instant around encode (~20 ns × 2413 ≈ 48 µs/token). packed() and vector() cache-hit add two more Instant pairs per call. Isolated families and addr/decode/simd probes run in separate CBs AFTER production generate 1 and are not inside the timed token. Organ GPU sum equals production GPU on the median-wall token (36,533,213 ns). First closed run without catalog clocks had median wall 249.7 ms; this run 250.7 ms — Instant overhead is not the 68 ms catalog bucket.

closure.identity: sum(14 serial components) == complete_token_wall; named residual is a row, not a hole
closure.named_residual: unattributed_residual = exclusive-clock composition overcount (−4.476 ms). Instant fields on one token over-sum the wall by 1.8%; folded so the table closes.

host_prep_split_ns.note: catalog.load_packed is called on every matvec_named even after the weight is already a resident MTLBuffer. That is 68.4 ms of mmap header reparse, not first-touch I/O.

gpu_organ_ns.note: bytes and time invert: routed is 10% of active bytes and 75% of GPU time; qkvz-class Q8 is most of the rest.

top_three_attacks.mechanism: Stop re-parsing the mixed catalog on every GEMV. 68.416 ms of host_preparation is catalog.load_packed after the tensor is already a no-copy MTLBuffer. 289 packed() calls/token walk mmap headers for geometry the session already knows.
top_three_attacks.expected_ns_recovered_note: 68 ms if packed() is skipped after ensure_named_weight. encode (2.4 ms) + embed gather (8.9 ms) + buffer write/read (4.9 ms) stay.

top_three_attacks.mechanism: Collapse 337 command buffers. wait−gpu is 83.375 ms (247 µs/CB). Qwen38 ships 1 CB / 964 dispatches. This path still commits ~7 CBs per layer (mixer groups + shared + router + routed wave + combine gate) plus terminal.
top_three_attacks.expected_ns_recovered_note: 75–83 ms if the token is one or a few CBs. Submit (1.2 ms) is already small. Cannot go below driver enqueue on the remaining CBs.

top_three_attacks.mechanism: Move DeltaNet recurrence off the host. source_qwen80_recurrent_deltanet is 43.518 ms of scalar CPU. Qwen38 already runs gated_delta_decode_vi on device. Conv is only 2.245 ms beside it.
top_three_attacks.expected_ns_recovered_note: 35–42 ms. Residual bandwidth floor of the rec-state tensor is ~0.01 ms. Rearrange/L2 (0.68 ms) and gated RMS (0.43 ms) can fuse with it.

evidence: binary 512-row gate: shipped tg256 11.25 µs vs q80_binary_group_matvec_simd 59.67 µs (0.19×) vs gk_matvec_binary_simd 51.50 µs (0.22×). Occupancy tile already beats simd.
hgravs down-R: shipped simd3 12.00 µs vs gk_matvec_hgravs_simd 20.33 µs (0.59×). 8-unpack simd3 stays.
Q8 qkvz 12288×2048: shipped tg256 69.38 µs vs q80_uniform8_matvec_simd_bytes 59.38 µs (1.17×). Modest, not the historical 8–45× (that was vs the serial bit-walk, now gone).

stale_profiles: Every pre-recon Q80 profile (gpu_matvec 867 ms / 74% of 1376 ms) is superseded. GPU is 36.5 ms / 14.6% of 250.7 ms. Host catalog + CB wait + host DeltaNet were invisible behind the serial extract.
action: Do not spend a lane on gk_*_simd wiring. The three existential mechanisms are host catalog reparse, 337-CB wait tax, and host DeltaNet recurrence. Weight addressing is 18.6 ms at 129 GB/s (3.2× the 411.51 GB/s floor) and is fourth.
